headline: Anthropic Faces Investor Pressure to Lower $1.5T IPO Valuation Amid Tech Slump
summary: Anthropic is facing pressure from investors to lower its $1.5 trillion valuation ahead of an IPO as technology stocks decline and computing costs outpace revenue growth.
why: Anthropic is a prominent artificial intelligence developer backed by major tech firms, and its valuation expectations serve as a bellwether for investor appetite in the AI sector.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Investor pressure to lower IPO valuation directly impacts the company's expected market capitalization.
